name: Pseudomasaris vespoides
desc: Pseudomasaris vespoides (Pseudomasaris vespoides): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 24 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pseudomasaris vespoides, the large pollen wasp, is a species of pollen wasp in the family Vespidae. This species can be found in the western United States as well as Baja California.
